title: Bias2Fair Synth
summary: A research pipeline evaluating how synthetic data generation and pre-processing interventions affect algorithmic bias and predictive performance on the COMPAS, Adult, and Diabetes datasets. The experiment script fits SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN and TVAE single-table synthesizers with conditional sampling to generate targeted synthetic oversampling for underrepresented subgroups, so SDV is run directly as the core synthetic-data engine of the study.
evidence: scripts/run_experiment.py:106-112 builds GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table, using sdv.metadata and sdv.sampling.Condition
